acip: RAB TU GUS PAR DE BZHIN GSHEGS PA DE LA MCHOD PA BYAS NA DE'I SDIG PA THAMS CAD DANG, LAS KYI SGRIB PA THAMS CAD DANG, NAD THAMS CAD RAB TU ZHI BAR 'GYUR, RE BA THAMS CAD YONGS SU RDZOGS PAR 'GYUR, SANGS RGYAS KYI BYANG CHUB LAS PHYIR MI LDOG PAR 'GYUR RO,,
wylie: rab tu gus par de bzhin gshegs pa de la mchod pa byas na de'i sdig pa thams cad dang, las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang, nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur, re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur, sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro
english: With this, and by making offerings—with intense devotion—to this particular Buddha, then all their bad deeds; and all their karmic obstacles; and all their illnesses will come to an end.  Every dream of their heart will come to pass; and they will be unstoppable in their pursuit of the enlightenment of the Buddhas. The eight prayers of Jewel Moon
